title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Tool Rental Invoices and Ridgeline Tool Rental Downtime Credits
content:
A business that runs its Ridgeline Tool Rental rentals through a Ridgeline Pro Credit account receives a larger downtime credit.

**Clause.** Pro Credit rental volume raises the credit: when the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account carries 4 or more tool rental invoices dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the credit is booked, the credit is multiplied by 1.05; when it carries 1 to 3 such invoices, by 1.02; when it carries none, it is unchanged.

The invoices counted are the invoices on the Ridgeline Pro Credit account whose purchase channel is tool rental. The credit is multiplied before it is rounded, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

| Tool rental invoices in the window | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 1.05 |
| 1, 2 or 3 | 1.02 |
| none | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical figures (credit of 600.00 before the multiplier)

| Tool rental invoices in the window | Figure |
|---|---|
| 6 | 630.00 |
| 2 | 612.00 |
| 0, the account carrying only lumber and fastener invoices | 600.00 |
